pieces.name: 3D viewer — render quality
pieces.judge: Side-by-side render of the same molecule. Sharpness at retina, atom shading, bond geometry, CPK colours.
pieces.gap: Awaiting critic verdict. Specular gloss not matched — 3Dmol shaders are pure diffuse; matching it means forking the library.

pieces.name: 3D viewer — selection & measurement
pieces.judge: Click an atom, then two/three/four. Does a highlight appear and a bond length / angle / dihedral read out?

pieces.name: 3D viewer — controls & settings menu
pieces.judge: Gear / fullscreen / reset controls. Auto-rotate, hide C–H bonds, download PNG.

pieces.name: Landing page
pieces.judge: Blind screenshot at 1280 and 375. Which reads as the more credible scientific product?
pieces.gap: Header/footer still max-w-6xl while content tightened to max-w-5xl, so edges no longer align. Belongs to the nav piece.

pieces.name: Calculation configuration
pieces.judge: Can a chemist set up a run without reading docs? Are units and valid ranges visible at the point of entry?

pieces.name: Results & property display
pieces.judge: Density and legibility of the property table. Every value carries a unit inline.

pieces.name: Scientific honesty & input validation
pieces.bar: The code itself — every claim must survive inspection
pieces.judge: Does any user-facing claim describe a capability the backend does not have? Does an unsupported calculationType fail loudly instead of silently returning a single-point?
pieces.gap: 19 stale validate_calculation.py references remain outside the fixed files. main.py returns HTTP 500 instead of 400 for a rejected calculationType.

pieces.name: Calculation manifest & audit trail
pieces.judge: Can a third party reproduce and verify any number the app displays, months later?

pieces.name: MACE Link shared viewer
pieces.judge: Load both embeds side by side. Which is the better shareable artifact?

pieces.name: Navigation & information architecture
pieces.judge: Can a first-time visitor find what the product does and start a calculation in two clicks?

pieces.name: Benchmark suite vs MP reference values
pieces.judge: Numeric. Do SimpleAtom's MACE-MP-0 formation energies agree with MP within a stated tolerance?

pieces.name: Responsive / mobile
pieces.judge: Blind screenshot at 375px. Which survives the phone better?

notes: Scope is MACE-only. No orbitals, partial charges, Fukui indices, pKa, docking, or DFT — MACE is an interatomic potential with no electron density.
Rowan's typeface Matter is commercially licensed and is not used. SimpleAtom keeps Fraunces + Inter.
Viewer pieces share one file and are serialised, not run in parallel.
Audit found results-display.tsx is dead code; metrics-dashboard.tsx is the live results component.
Audit found FIRE optimizer advertised in docs and landing copy, but BFGS is hardcoded in mace-api/calculate.py. Being corrected.
Of Rowan's ~30 workflows: 2 already shipped, 18 buildable on MACE, 13 blocked by the absence of any electron-density model.
Measured: both our viewer and Rowan render at exactly devicePixelRatio 2.00. The original DPR-1 premise was wrong — 3Dmol upscales by default when antialias is on.
Blind label-stripping was not achievable for the qualitative comparison; critics run with fresh context and an adversarial brief instead. Stated rather than claimed otherwise.
